A young woman, aged 20-30, gracefully wielding a sword in a springtime setting, wearing a flowing light blue traditional Chinese-style dress adorned with delicate patterns, the fabric as thin as gossamer, exuding elegance and fluidity. Her hairstyle is adorned with intricate hairpins, silver ornaments, and floral decorations, adding a touch of refined beauty. She holds the sword with both hands, striking a dynamic pose with a side turn, the blade entwined with white flowers, creating smooth and powerful lines. The perspective is slightly close-up, viewed from the right side at a subtle downward angle, capturing the intricate details of her movements.

The background features a serene spring countryside, with tree branches adorned with white blossoms, evoking the vitality and beauty of nature. The setting is slightly hazy, with soft gray-green tones complementing the cool light blue of her attire, creating a harmonious and gentle color palette. The overall style is realistic and romantic, blending tranquility and a hint of heroic spirit, vividly portraying the essence of an ancient heroine.

The composition is horizontal, focusing on the woman and the natural surroundings, with her dynamic pose and the delicate branches forming a balanced and visually engaging scene.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 用法> 按图层顺序逐步设置   
 背景图层：设置全局图像的尺寸、背景颜色  （工作流会自动将所有输入图像限制在输入的全局尺寸大小之内）
 其它图层：载入图像并选择用何种方式抠图  （可以选择是否抠图、可以选择3种抠图方式）

 我个人因有强迫症，所以节点版面多少会显得会方方正正，为避免注意力分散，不需要修改参数的节点会被最小化或隐藏起来
 不习惯可自行更改，自由变换窗口最大支持8层，若想无限层，可再拉Compositor进行套娃   

                                                                                                   @Showevr/2025/6/21
用英文详细描述这张图片，请直接描述内容，不要用The image depicts、The image features、The image shows、The image showcases、This photo captures...这类废话作为开头

>图层接入端口有8个，每一个接口的图像，
  对应左边的【图层混合后输出的预览】中的混合图像后的结果
  如果你只用到三层图层，
  可将【总线接口】的输入设置为“【图层3】混合后输出”就OK
